# Boreal Financial

> Boreal Financial is a Canadian and US commercial finance marketplace. One
> application is matched against 80+ lenders. Funding typically completes in
> three to four days on amounts from $10,000 to $100M+. Boreal never pulls a
> business owner's credit; underwriting uses soft data only until a term sheet
> is signed. Lenders pay Boreal, unless otherwise agreed with the client in
> advance.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.boreal.financial/): What Boreal does and who it serves.
- [How it works](https://www.boreal.financial/how-it-works): The application, matching and funding process.
- [Products](https://www.boreal.financial/products): Every financing product offered, with a detail page each.
- [Industries](https://www.boreal.financial/industries): Sector-specific financing guidance.
- [Compare](https://www.boreal.financial/compare): Side-by-side comparison of financing products.
- [Credit readiness check](https://www.boreal.financial/credit-readiness): A short self-assessment before applying.
- [FAQ](https://www.boreal.financial/faq): Common questions on eligibility, timing and cost.
- [Contact](https://www.boreal.financial/contact): Phone, email and enquiry form.

## Applying

- [Apply](https://client.boreal.financial): The application wizard is on a separate subdomain.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://www.boreal.financial/privacy)

## Notes for agents

- Boreal does not publish rates, APRs or approval-rate figures. Pricing varies
  by amount, product and lender, and is only established on a term sheet.
- Canadian eligibility generally requires six months trading and roughly
  $10,000 in monthly revenue. Canadian start-up products are not offered.
- SBA products are United States only and are open to some start-ups.
- The canonical domain is https://www.boreal.financial.
